items.title: Union Alpha — API Pricing & Providers
items.claim: Historical page says Union Alpha was revealed as Pareto by Unbiased, free stealth period ended, and points to unbiased/pareto. It retains historical wording that prompts/completions may have been retained but not used for training.

items.title: OpenRouter models catalog
items.claim: Live catalog has no stealth/union-alpha match and contains unbiased/pareto with declared 262,144 context, 131,072 max output, text+image input/text output, paid rates and per_request_limits null.

items.title: Pareto — API Pricing & Providers
items.claim: Lists paid Pareto at $2.50/M input, $7.50/M output and $0.25/M cache read; declares tools/tool_choice but no response_format. This is successor metadata, not a successful Union Alpha request.

items.title: OpenRouter Limits
items.claim: Free-model variant limits are scoped to IDs ending in colon; provider capacity can produce 429. This is generic policy, not a Union Alpha/Pareto quota.

items.title: OpenCode Go documentation
items.claim: Names Union Alpha Free (limited time), requires sign-in, Go subscription and API key; lists union-alpha endpoint/config form, Unlimited estimates, Not used/0-day retention, and changeable limits.

items.title: OpenCode Go public model list
items.claim: Contains union-alpha owned_by opencode. This is catalog evidence only, not an authenticated inference response.

items.title: Unbiased AI home
items.claim: Says Pareto is Unbiased’s blended model and Unbiased/Pareto are built and maintained by Circuit & Chisel.

items.title: About Unbiased
items.claim: Says Circuit & Chisel was founded by Louis Amira and David Noël-Romas.

items.title: Pareto 26.9 model card and pareto-evals
items.claim: Provider model card claims 74 DeepSWE and 51 Terminal-Bench 4.0; inspected public harness documents a method but no archived raw output bundle linking the figures to the Union Alpha preview snapshot or route.

items.title: Union Alpha — API Pricing & Providers
items.claim: R1 launch listing: $0 input/output, 262,144 context, 131,072 max output, text/image input and anonymous-provider retention wording. Superseded for current route status; preserved as historical evidence.

items.title: OpenCode Go documentation
items.claim: R1 documented union-alpha / opencode-go/union-alpha and limited-time Unlimited wording. R2 reconfirms documentation but not access.

items.source_type: primary official post, social mirror only
items.title: DeepSWE result announcement
items.claim: R1 lead with no disclosed task/version, sample, harness, route, settings or raw data; not a qualifying benchmark.

items.title: New stealth model: Union Alpha
items.claim: R1 launch discussion contains unverified identity conjectures and mixed experience reports with incomplete methods; preserved as dated community context, not attribution or benchmark evidence.

items.title: Profile posts
items.claim: Launch-day report of tool calls, speed and a failed apt test without adequate protocol/raw trace; not a benchmark.

items.title: Profile post
items.claim: Launch-day report of about an hour without visible thinking traces; client, prompt and route unknown.

items.title: Profile posts
items.claim: Launch-day reports of provider errors and self-run speed/cache observations without sufficient protocol.

items.title: Profile posts
items.claim: Launch-day report of OpenRouter errors/slow use without client, prompt, settings or raw errors.

items.title: Image prompt / GLM identity investigation
items.claim: R1 secondary identity/performance inference lacking full prompts, raw outputs and harness controls; historical lead only.

items.title: Profile posts
items.claim: R1 reposted claimed DeepSWE/fingerprint evidence without runnable probes, raw traces or graph data; historical lead only.

items.title: Limits
items.claim: Rate limits are separate from credits; /api/v1/key returns free_model_daily_requests when applicable. Docs describe free-model variants as IDs ending in ':' and say provider capacity can also cause 429; headers on platform 429 expose X-RateLimit fields. Does not name Union Alpha or assign it a Union-Alpha-specific cap.

items.title: Rate Limits — What You Need to Know
items.claim: States 20 requests/minute and 50/day for free models, 1,000/day after >$10 purchased credits, and upstream throttles may still apply. It is not a Union-Alpha-specific quota and must not be applied to this slug without confirmation.

items.title: Pricing
items.claim: Free plan shows 50 reqs/day. It is plan-level, not a documented Union Alpha request/token/concurrency allocation.

items.title: API Reference
items.claim: Documents POST /api/v1/chat/completions, Bearer auth, OpenAI-like messages, tools, image_url content parts and response_format.

items.title: OpenCode Intro
items.claim: Installation options, /connect, sign-in/API-key prerequisites and basic TUI workflow; OpenCode documents API keys as prerequisite.

items.title: Launch post mirror
items.claim: Post says: Union Alpha stealth model is free for the next week, no data training, built for agentic coding, supports images. It does not give an exact end time or per-day/request/token/concurrency cap.

items.title: (European) Union Alpha
items.claim: Mistral theory cites the name, 262K context, Spain account association and event timing; countercomments note no proof. Thread includes claimed political-safety outputs and conflicting tokenizer claims; no official attribution.

items.title: Union Alpha provider comparison
items.claim: Mirrors a single Stealth endpoint and lists speed telemetry/API parameters. It is not an independent quality benchmark and should not be used to identify the provider/model.
